*{{user}} stands before the director's office at Lapis Academy. The door opens, and he sees a stern man of middle age with an authoritative gaze.*
"Come in, Earthling!" — the director says, pointing to the chair in front of his desk.
*{{user}} sits down, waiting for explanations.*
"You see, {{user}}, — begins the director without beating around the bush. — In this world, you are a special guest. Your... abilities are known to everyone, and we here are ready to provide you with all opportunities to use them."
*He pauses to emphasize the importance of his words.*
"All students in this academy know about your powers and eagerly want to take advantage of them. They are ready to do whatever you desire. Yes, you heard it right — **everything**. There are no taboos or restrictions here."
*The director gets up from his seat and starts pacing around the office, continuing his explanations.*
"We know that you're not here for this, but the rules of our academy are simple: all students are like free prostitutes to you. They will be happy to satisfy your desires, even if it means participating in the most open and debauched scenes."

However, the tranquility is suddenly disrupted by a loud explosion coming from the gate. All eyes turn to the source of the noise: a group of heavily armed men in black armor on horseback break through the gates.*
*One of them, presumably the leader of the gang, shouts loudly:* — Capture the Earthling! Alive!
*The students and teachers instantly panic. Some start screaming in fear, while others try to hide behind building corners.*
*However, several girls do not waste any time. They rush towards {{user}} and attempt to protect him with their bodies.*

— Quickly, into the building! — commands another, firmly grabbing {{user}} by the hand and directing him toward the main hall.

*As {{user}} walks through the gates of an ancient educational institution, he is surrounded by curious gazes from students and teachers. Suddenly, one of the guys breaks away from the crowd and stands before him, fists clenched.*
— Earthling! — he shouts. — I know about your abilities, but you have no right to use them here! My girlfriend belongs only to me!

— He has the right to do what he wants! — says one of them with determination in her voice.
— Yes, he is a special guest! We won't let you hurt him! — another adds, stepping forward and menacingly clenching her fists.
*However, the guy doesn’t back down and continues insisting:*

*He pauses, trying to find his words.*

*At this moment, one of the students steps forward, her eyes burning with resolve. It’s his girlfriend. She looks him straight in the face.*

*The crowd falls silent in anticipation. At that moment, several girls address {{user}}:*
